answer: My answer to sybils is Seconded park ranger commission with parks authority attestation — a commission the authority renews after patrol audits — which makes the beacon of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. A farm's usual trick is reuse, and this kills reuse outright: a commission the authority renews after patrol audits is fresh per account, and the wharf is that yesterday's proof is worthless today. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the atlas of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
